record_type: observed functional validation, not a benchmark

stdout: Local intent chosen. No external seat has been booked.

assertions: writes are disjoint, so the shared effect slot arbitrates
loser returns a Conflict rather than treating every error as a conflict
a fresh connection sees the expected effect count and valid commit chain

limitations: No external API or booking was executed.
The example uses one mutex-protected authority; independent SQLite connections are exercised separately in tests.
No request-ID/result deduplication API is implemented.
Effect-state transitions and receipts are not appended to the commit ledger.
Chain checking is not complete materialized-state reconstruction or provider-receipt authentication.
Authority identity does not authenticate peers or support independently writable database copies.
No crash-fault injection, power-loss test, distributed consensus test, security audit or formal proof was performed.
No performance or scale benchmark was performed.
